Title: Remote Data Quality Assurance Engineer
Description: Req ID: 367237 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. We are currently seeking a Remote Data Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team in Monterrey, Nuevo León (MX-NLE), Mexico (MX). We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Quality Assurance Engineer to lead data validation and data quality assurance for a large-scale cloud modernization initiative. In this senior technical leadership role, you will ensure the delivery of reliable, high-quality data solutions across enterprise systems by driving best practices in data quality, ETL processes, and data standardization. You will develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies for data migration, integration, and transformation, while partnering with cross-functional teams to enable automated data quality assurance and operational excellence. This position offers the opportunity to shape trusted, cloud-based data solutions that power analytics, AI/ML, and digital innovation across the organization at a global scale. Job Duties Leadership & Strategy Lead QA planning, strategy, and execution for data migration projects with multiple concurrent releases. Provide guidance and mentorship to the DQA team (onshore, offshore, nearshore) to ensure timely, accurate test completion and defect resolution. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across teams. Serve as the primary escalation point for Data Quality Assurance (DQA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in test strategies, automation, and quality engineering. Testing & Automation Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks for validating data pipelines and transformations. Develop and maintain automated test scripts for ingestion, transformation, and output validation to ensure comprehensive coverage. Support development teams in adopting shift-left testing practices to improve quality early in the lifecycle. Drive quality innovation through new technologies, testing tools, and automation solutions. Compliance & Governance Ensure adherence to data quality dimensions, industry best practices, SOX compliance, and security policies to maintain data integrity and confidentiality. Maintain detailed audit trails and documentation to support internal and external reviews. Drive process compliance and governance through accurate reporting and documentation. Reporting & Communication Deliver clear, actionable reporting on test execution, coverage, and defect trends to inform leadership decisions. Provide go/no-go recommendations based on test results and risk assessments. Promote technical excellence and knowledge sharing across teams. Collaborate in daily stand-up meetings. What makes you a dream candidate? Knowledge Champions a data quality-first mindset with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Deep expertise in data profiling, validation, standardization, and cleansing to ensure trusted data assets. Experience in large-scale data migrations, including on-premises to cloud transitions, Medallion architecture, data warehousing, lakehouse, and delta frameworks. Proficient in Python and Unix/Linux scripting. Solid understanding of project management, agile, and SDLC principles. Proven ability to design and implement robust data quality test cases, constraints and triggers with a strong emphasis on anomaly detection and prevention (left shift). Skills Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value while fostering stakeholder trust and collaboration. Strong organizational and time management capabilities, ensuring effective prioritization and timely delivery. Proven track record of driving process improvements and implementing automation techniques to enhance efficiency and quality. Ability to apply critical thinking and creativity to solve complex problems, make informed decisions independently, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Qualifications & Technical Skills ETL, Informatica & DataBricks experience. Data migration experience is a plus. Bachelor’s Degree in related field or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of hands-on experience in data quality or data governance role with a focus on test data management, including at least 2 years in a lead or senior QA role. 5+ years of advanced experience querying complex data structures and performing root-cause analysis. Advanced knowledge of ETL process and techniques. Title: COORDINADOR DE ANALITICA DE DATOS E INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL

Identificar las necesidades del cliente interno y necesidades del negocio, para determinar el impacto, alcances, inversión y tiempo. Garantizar la calidad, integridad y gobernanza de los datos utilizados en los procesos analíticos. Evaluar nuevas tecnologías y metodologías de IA para su aplicación en la organización. Supervisar la extracción, transformación y modelado de datos desde diversas fuentes (SAP, Datasphere, etc.). Desarrollar dashboards, reportes y modelos predictivos utilizando herramientas como Qlik Sense y SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) ¿Qué buscamos? Requisitos del puesto Formación académica: Licenciatura o Ingeniería en Tecnologías Computacionales, afín. Experiencia de 3 a 5 años en: 1. Planeación: 1.1 Metodología Ágil. 1.2 Conocimientos Básicos de Administración de Proyectos. 1.3 Excel Avanzado. 1.4 Familiaridad con frameworks de machine learning y herramientas de IA 1.5 Machine Learning, Modelos Predictivos 2. Base de Datos 2.1 MS SQL Server, Postgress, MySQL 2.2 SAP HANA 2.4 Database 4D 3. Herramientas de BI 3.1 QlikView, QlikSense, Nprinting, SAP BW, 3.2 Qlik Publisher y Qlik Sense SaaS Connection 3.3 Power BI 3.4 Dominio de procesos ETL y modelado de datos (relacional y multidimensional) 3.5 SAP SAC, Datasphere. 4. Title: Analyst, Biorefinery and biofuels
Description: About The Role Grade Level (for internal use): 09 The Team: The Biofuels Research and Analytics division of S&P Global Energy Horizons provides ‘well to wheels’ coverage of the global biofuels market, providing fundamental insights and developing views on the emerging trends that will drive the long-term development of biofuels. The team is responsible for generating long-term forecasts of biofuels supply and demand, as well as the future value and margins of biofuels. The team consists of analysts and researchers worldwide, each covering their respective markets or niches and collaborating with other teams within the broader S&P Global Commodity Insights organization. What’s In It For You You will be at the forefront of a rapidly developing industry, and this role offers opportunities to develop in-depth knowledge of the biofuels sector and its role in Energy Transition and the decarbonization of the energy sector. While your focus will be primarily on developing and refining the biorefinery margin model, you will also have a hand in deciphering the biofuels and biogas sector on a global scale. You will be collaborating with a global team and have exposure and access to other expertise in associated industries. Responsibilities And Impact This role will lead the maintenance and improvement of the biorefinery margins model, with the aim of further building out its capabilities to cover both emerging production pathways and existing biofuels and biogas production plants. This is a unique hybrid role, and we are seeking the best combination of skills and experience in refining, programming and/or data science. Responsibilities We are looking for a highly motivated individual who would like to join an international team of like-minded people. You are applying for a dynamic career path within a nascent though growing environment. More specifically, responsibilities include: Lead development and maintenance of the BCMA tool, improving model structure, inputs, assumptions, and documentation. Support biomethane research, particularly RNG supply, demand, pricing, policy, and market dynamics. Troubleshoot model and data issues quickly, identify root causes, and implement long‑term fixes. Build and maintain Python workflows for data ingestion, cleaning, validation, and automation. Use SQL to extract and validate data; work with partners to improve data quality and lineage. Interpret model outputs and clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, and risks. Explain model updates and their workflow impacts to non‑technical stakeholders. Maintain clear, reproducible documentation for models and recurring processes. Run end‑to‑end analyses—from defining questions to interpreting and communicating results. Contribute to written research and client deliverables with accurate, timely insights. Enhance the biogas/biomethane cost and margin framework as the role evolves. Manage multiple deadlines, flag risks early, and balance competing priorities. Collaborate across a distributed team and contribute to continuous improvement. What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another relevant quantitative program (with equivalent experience). Advanced Python skills are essential for troubleshooting, workflow construction, automation, and robust model validation; SQL proficiency is required. Strong team orientation—comfortable collaborating, sharing knowledge, and mentoring/uplifting colleagues when needed. Prior understanding of biofuels, refining and/or gas markets is preferred but not required. Excellent English writing and presentation skills. A self-starter with the ability to work to deadlines and prioritize a complex workload with limited supervision. Must be flexible with the ability to work collaboratively. About S&P Global Energy At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration. S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction.
